title: AI office task: harden strategy ranking against weak evidence
body:
Review strategy ranking for insufficient sample sizes, missing metrics, and non-finite values. Add regression tests and only make the smallest fix needed if a real defect is demonstrated. Preserve all existing profitability qualification thresholds. Do not change trade signals, capital allocation, risk limits, or execution behavior. Do not claim any strategy is profitable.

Files: strategy_ranking.py, tests/test_strategy_ranking.py

title: AI office task: strengthen multi-market data-quality regression tests
body:
Review multi-market opportunity scanning for stale, missing, malformed, or future-dated quotes/candles. Add regression tests and make a minimal fail-closed fix only if a reproducible gap exists. Preserve provider contracts and unit validation. Do not change strategy signals, wallet sizing, or live execution.

Files: multi_market_opportunity_scan.py, tests/test_multi_market_opportunity_scan.py

title: AI office task: validate shared paper-ledger state recovery
body:
Review shared paper portfolio state loading for missing, malformed, partial, or inconsistent persisted state. Add regression tests and a minimal validation fix only where needed. Never silently reset cash, equity, positions, or trade history. Preserve accounting, allocations, and paper-only safeguards. Do not add any exchange order submission or execution.

Files: shared_paper_portfolio.py, tests/test_shared_paper_portfolio.py

title: AI office task: convert repair findings into safe, actionable patch plans
body:
Improve the existing deterministic repair advisor so failed QA results produce a structured, evidence-backed repair task: identify the failed check, exact source file and regression test from a fixed mapping, sanitized bounded error excerpt, severity, and retry count. Add tests for unknown failure types, secret/token redaction, log truncation, and paper-safety failures. For paper-safety or live-trading mismatch, stop and recommend human intervention; never generate a code patch. Keep the advisor proposal-only in this task: do not create PRs, modify workflows, change risk or trading behavior, weaken tests, or auto-merge. Link this phase to issue #165; workflow integration will be a separately reviewed step.

Files: whj_repair_advisor.py, tests/test_whj_repair_advisor.py
